title: Asahina Wakaba & Her Chubby-Chubby Boyfriend
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Shy, clumsy Asahina Wakaba is the most disliked girl in her class, and classmates force her to make a fake love confession to Haruto Iruma, the heavyset otaku the class looks down on, as a punishment game. Haruto turns out to be warm and kind, and their relationship turns her bleak high school years around while her buried pain and mental health struggles surface.
life_message: Kindness and acceptance from one person can carry someone through bullying and inner pain, and looks are a poor guide to worth.
